Ensure all content is well-structured, readable, and aligned with target keyword intent

Implement schema markup and structured data to enhance search result appearances



3) Technical SEO

Perform regular technical SEO audits using tools such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console

Identify and resolve issues including crawl errors, broken links, duplicate content, and redirect chains

Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed performance across desktop and mobile

Manage XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and canonical tags to ensure proper indexation

Ensure the site is fully crawlable, indexable, and technically sound at all times



4) Content SEO & Optimization

Work with content writers to produce SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and product pages

Audit existing content and provide optimization recommendations to improve rankings

Build and maintain a content calendar aligned with SEO opportunities and seasonal trends

Refresh and update underperforming content to improve rankings and organic traffic

Ensure all published content meets on-page SEO standards before going live



5) Link Building & Off-Page SEO

Develop and execute white-hat link building strategies to grow domain authority

Identify and pursue guest posting, digital PR, and outreach opportunities

Monitor the backlink profile using tools such as Ahrefs or SEMrush and disavow toxic links

Build relationships with relevant websites and publishers for ongoing link acquisition

Track referring domains, new backlinks, and authority growth over time



6) Reporting & Analytics

Track and report on key SEO metrics weekly and monthly: organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, CTR, and conversions

Use Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and SEO tools to measure performance

Provide clear, data-backed reports with insights and prioritized action items

Monitor algorithm updates and assess their impact on rankings and traffic



Requirements

Proven experience in SEO with measurable results in organic traffic and keyword ranking improvements

Strong proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console

Solid understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO best practices

Experience performing technical SEO audits and resolving site health issues

Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) and the ability to interpret organic traffic data

Strong understanding of search intent and how to align content to meet user needs

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities

Up-to-date knowledge of Google algorithm updates and their implications

Nice to Have

Experience with eCommerce SEO including product page and category page optimization

Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, or other CMS platforms for implementing on-page changes

Experience with local SEO including Google Business Profile optimization

Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for implementing technical SEO recommendations directly

Content writing or editing experience with an SEO focus

Performance Expectations (Important)

Consistently improve organic keyword rankings and grow organic traffic month over month

Maintain a technically clean, well-optimized website with no major crawl or indexation issues

Deliver a steady pipeline of quality backlinks through ethical, white-hat outreach

Produce timely SEO reports with clear performance data and prioritized recommendations

Stay ahead of algorithm changes and proactively adjust strategy as needed

Provide clear communication and measurable progress toward agreed SEO goals



To Apply, Please Send

1. Your resume

2. Portfolio or case studies showing SEO results — include before/after traffic data, ranking improvements, or domain authority growth

3. List the SEO tools you use regularly and your proficiency level with each

4. Brief overview of your link building approach and examples of campaigns you have run

5. Your internet speed (MBPS)



Important

Please apply only if you have:

Proven, hands-on SEO experience with real, documented results

Strong technical SEO knowledge — not just content-level optimization

Experience with industry-standard SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, GSC, Screaming Frog)

Reliable internet connection and the ability to consistently meet deadlines

title: Shopify Technical SEO Implementation Specialist (Short-Term Project)
description:

## IMPORTANT — Please Read Before Applying



This is NOT:



* An SEO management role

* A long-term SEO retainer

* A content writing role

* A link building role

* A 6-12 month consulting engagement

* A project where we need another full technical audit

---

* Established Shopify ecommerce store

* Shopify Markets enabled

* Multiple international locales

* Significant decline in indexed pages over recent months

* Existing technical assessment and implementation roadmap available



---

* Validate the existing findings

* Prioritize fixes

* Provide clear implementation instructions

* Implement Shopify-side fixes where appropriate

* Work with the developer when deeper theme-level changes are required

* Verify successful implementation and results



---

* Duplicate URL handling

* Crawl inefficiencies

* High volume of "Crawled – currently not indexed" pages

* Redirect chain and redirect efficiency issues

* robots.txt review and optimization

* Indexation stabilization

* Defining canonical fixes across Shopify templates

* Reviewing robots.txt.liquid requirements

* Reviewing sitemap structure and indexation signals

---

* Ecommerce SEO

* Google Search Console

* Canonical implementation and troubleshooting

* Crawlability and indexability optimization

* Shopify Markets

* hreflang implementation

* robots.txt strategy

* Redirect management

* Shopify URL structures



---



## Preferred Experience



* Shopify Plus

* Large ecommerce catalogs

* Faceted navigation SEO

* Crawl budget optimization

* Large-scale indexation recovery projects

* Advanced Screaming Frog usage



---



## Required Tools



* Google Search Console

* Screaming Frog

* Shopify Admin

* Ahrefs and/or Semrush



---



## Budget & Timeline

* Immediate start preferred

* Goal: Complete highest-priority implementation work within approximately 1 week

* Maximum expected timeframe: 1–2 weeks



### Budget

---

---

title: Full Charge Bookkeeper (Controller)

The Controller will be responsible for full-cycle accounting and FP&A, including AP, AR, payroll, bank and credit card reconciliations, cash management, and monthly financial reporting. This role will oversee accounting for property acquisitions, capitalized rehab and turn costs, rental and property management operations, and property sales, optimize the current QuickBooks Online environment, and implement and manage a structured monthly close calendar to ensure timely and accurate reporting. The Controller will also support the evaluation and implementation of accounting and operational systems, including CRMs, and play a key role in planning and executing a future ERP migration from QuickBooks Online to Sage Intacct.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis to management

• Maintain accurate cost-of-goods-sold and margin reporting 

• Ensure compliance with GAAP standards and internal accounting controls 

• Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and automate tasks 



Minimum Qualifications 



• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (preferred)

• Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management 

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Key Attributes for Success 



• Communication skills in English, both verbal and written 

• Ability to prioritize, organize, manage time, and work independently to meet deadlines 

• Strong analytical, organizational, attention to detail, problem-solving, and leadership 

• High degree of professionalism and tact in dealing with internal and external partners

Perks and Benefits

title: Paid Media Specialist — Search, Social & YouTube Ads

Creative Content Strategy:  Collaborate with creative teams to brief, test, and iterate on high-converting ad assets for paid social, YouTube, and display/remarketing campaigns based on performance data rather than ‘gut feel.

The founder and clients have total visibility into which channels are driving high-quality pipeline.

Campaigns are managed proactively; the team never has to ask for an update on spend or performance.



Requirements

Analytical Rigor: You don't just "run ads"—you measure them scientifically and understand the math behind B2B SaaS growth.

Platform Expertise:  Proven experience managing paid spend across Google Ads and at least one major paid social platform, such as LinkedIn or Meta, for B2B audiences.

title: Growth Marketing & Sales Specialist — SEO, Ads & Lead Conversion (Australian Service Business)
description:

The business runs well — now we want to grow it. This role is the growth engine: get us found, generate leads, and convert them into booked jobs.



The role:

You own everything from "stranger finds us online" to "job is booked." You generate demand (SEO, ads, content), then convert it (respond to enquiries, quote, follow up, close). Once a job is booked, you hand to the owner, who runs the team and schedule. Your success is measured in one number: booked jobs.



What you'll own:

- Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimisation, local-pack rankings, service-area/suburb landing pages, citations/NAP consistency, review generation strategy

- Website optimisation & CRO: improve the site to rank and to convert visitors into enquiries

- Paid ads: plan, build and optimise Google (incl. Local Services Ads) and Meta campaigns — manage budget to a target cost-per-booked-job

- Content & social: consistent, locally-relevant content that supports SEO and brand

- Lead conversion / sales: respond fast to enquiries, prepare and send quotes (from customer photos — no site visits), follow up, and close the booking

- Reporting: track leads, conversion rate, cost-per-lead, cost-per-booking, and ROAS



You'll thrive here if you:

- Have a proven record growing a local/home-services business (or similar) — not just ecommerce or SaaS

- Can show real results: rankings, traffic, leads, and ROAS you personally drove

- Know local SEO deeply and live in Search Console, GA4, and your ads platforms

- Are commercially minded and comfortable on the phone/email closing residential customers

- Are fluent, natural in English (written and spoken)

- Work independently and own outcomes, not just tasks



Hours:

Full-time. You set your own focus time, but you must be reachable during Brisbane business hours (7-4) for fast lead response (speed wins bookings).



Pay:

Pay & growth path

We start low and pay you up fast as you prove results — no commission, just a rising wage tied to clear milestones.



Starting: AUD $900/month (3-month trial)

Rising to $1,100 ? $1,300 ? $1,500+/month as you hit agreed targets (leads, bookings, ROAS)

Reviewed at 3, 6 and 12 months — and we'll move you up early if you hit milestones early.

This is a build-and-grow-with-us role. If you generate real revenue, you'll be paid like it.



How to apply — read carefully (this is also our first filter)

Reply with:



1. Two real case studies with specific numbers (rankings before/after, organic traffic, leads, ad spend and ROAS) — include the website URLs or GBP profiles so we can verify

title: Digital Marketing Campaign Manager (Australia)
description:
Full-time remote, from the Philippines. Melbourne business hours. Above-market pay. Long-term. Direct to the agency director.



A four-in-one role: set the strategy, run the campaigns, prove the results, lead the client conversation.



This is a senior, client-facing seat inside an established Australian digital agency — the person every campaign flows through. You'll work directly with the agency director, own a portfolio of Australian SME clients, and run integrated campaigns end-to-end across SEO, Google Ads, and paid + organic social. Real ownership, real variety, and a clear path to coordinator or senior as the agency grows.





Why this role



You'll work directly with the agency director. Your strategy, your campaigns, your client calls — no layer in between.



A real seat at an established agency. A growing Australian digital agency with a real client book — you'll own multiple Australian SME accounts across varied industries, not stuck on one.



Above-market pay, reliably on time. This is not a budget hire.



Long-term and stable. Full-time, ongoing, with a clear path to coordinator or senior as the agency grows.



Variety of clients and industries. Multiple parallel accounts, varied verticals, real briefs — you'll deepen your craft fast.



A small, high-trust team. Agency director, design team, build team, and you running the campaigns. No layers, no committees, no internal politics.





The brief



A growing Australian digital marketing agency is hiring a full-time Digital Marketing Campaign Manager to join the team remotely from the Philippines.



You plan the campaign, execute across paid and organic channels, report what worked and what didn't, and talk the client through it — calmly, in clear English, on camera. Campaigns span SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic) across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn. You are the person the agency director hands a client to and trusts to deliver.



If you are a deep specialist in one channel who'd rather not be in front of a client — this role is not for you.





The team you'll work with



You'll sit alongside the agency director (who handles sales and overall direction), the agency's design team (creative and ad assets), the build team (web and tech), and a small group of specialist partners. A small, capable, Melbourne-anchored agency — and you as the strategy-and-execution lead on the campaigns you run.





What you'll do



01 — Strategy. Develop integrated campaign plans spanning SEO, Google Ads,
, and social — paid and organic, across
, Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels. Run competitor analysis and translate findings into campaign opportunities, not slide decks. Articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes in a plan a client can read. Build and maintain content calendars and campaign schedules. Advise on channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation — and defend your reasoning.



02 — Execution. Set up, monitor, and optimise Google Ads — keyword research, ad copy, audience targeting, bid management. Implement and manage SEO programs — technical audits, on-page optimisation, content briefs, link building. Manage social media accounts — organic posting, community engagement, and paid execution across Meta and LinkedIn. Track performance live and adjust based on data, not on quarterly reviews. Brief copy, creative, and design support when the campaign needs it, and hold the bar.



03 — Reporting & analytics. Build and maintain custom client reporting in Looker Studio. Produce monthly performance reports covering ROI, traffic, conversions, audience growth, and campaign metrics. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush or Ahrefs, and Meta Ads Manager to inform strategy and validate results. Translate numbers into recommendations the client can act on. Flag what isn't working early and propose the change.



04 — Client engagement. Join discovery calls and ongoing client meetings alongside the agency director. Help prepare strategy presentations and campaign proposals for new and existing clients. Walk clients through progress, insights, and recommendations — clearly, in writing and on video. Handle questions and pushback without losing the room. Be the trusted face of the agency on the campaigns you run.





What we're looking for



We're hiring for strategic judgement, execution discipline, and client poise — not a rigid checklist. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



Essential



5+ years hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple client accounts.



Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be on video calls with Australian SME owners and senior marketers, presenting strategy and walking through results.



Proven ability to plan and execute integrated campaigns across SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic).



Strong working knowledge of: Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, SEMrush or Ahrefs, Meta Ads Manager, and social scheduling tools.



Track record of building campaign plans that articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes.



Experience translating competitor analysis into actionable campaign moves.



Self-motivated and able to work independently without close supervision.



Reliable home internet and a dedicated, professional home workspace.



Nice to have (not required)



Marketing copywriting — taglines, calls to action, ad copy, social captions.



Familiarity with WordPress for blog posting and basic content updates.



Canva or similar for social media graphics.



 marketing platforms and campaign execution.



Meta advertising compliance, including 18+ ad categories.



Comfort contributing to client-facing meetings and presenting strategy.



Out of scope



Graphic design specialism — the agency has a design team.



Sales and new-business development — the agency director handles client acquisition.



Production-level web development — handled by the build team.





Who you are



You're a strategist who also ships. You can sit on a discovery call with an Australian SME owner, draw the goal out of them, and walk out with a campaign plan you can defend. You like the discipline of Looker Studio more than the noise of vanity metrics. You're comfortable on camera — you can hold the room when a client pushes back, concede what should be conceded, and defend what shouldn't. And you'd rather have a long-term seat at a respected agency than bounce between freelance gigs.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.





How it works



1. Application review. We assess your resume, portfolio, and answers against the brief. Strong fits move to interview.

2. Interview. A 45-minute video interview with the agency director. We discuss your background, your campaigns, how you work with clients, and how you think about strategy.

3. Paid trial. The strongest candidate is offered a paid initial trial on a probationary basis.





How to Apply



Apply directly via OJP. Attach:



1. Your resume (PDF).

2. Work samples / portfolio — link or PDF. We want to see real campaign work you've run: campaign plans, Looker Studio reports, ad creative, post-campaign write-ups. One strong case study beats a long list.



In your application message, answer these three questions. Short, direct answers — no AI fluff.



1. One campaign, end-to-end. Pick one campaign you owned. Business goal, channel mix (SEO / Google Ads / paid social / organic), what you measured, what the data told you mid-flight, what you changed, and what the campaign actually delivered. 8–12 lines.



2. Client pushback. You're on a video call with an Australian SME owner who disagrees with a recommendation you believe is right. Walk us through a real example — how you held the room, what you conceded, and what you defended.



3. Logistics. Expected full-time monthly salary in PHP, earliest start date, home internet speed, and confirm you can work Melbourne business hours (Mon–Fri).



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Creative Strategist & Content Producer
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: SENIOR WEB DEVELOPER (FIGMA-TO-ELEMENTOR) - AUSTRALIAN AGENCY
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're Marketing One (M1), a specialist paid media agency in Brisbane, Australia. We build and run Google and Meta ad campaigns for home service brands (plumbers, electricians, HVAC) and law firms. Our ads send a lot of traffic to a lot of landing pages, and those pages need to be fast, clean, and built to convert. That's where you come in.

 

As our Senior Web Developer, your main job is turning design into reality. You'll take Figma files and build them into pixel-accurate, fast-loading WordPress pages in Elementor. Day to day that means landing pages, full client websites, and ongoing build work that directly affects whether a campaign makes money or burns budget.

 

You'll also be the hands that implement SEO on our client sites. Our Head of SEO sets the strategy and hands you the work, and you make the changes on-page and on the back end. So while you don't need to be an SEO expert, knowing your way around the fundamentals will make your life a lot easier.

 

This is not a ticket-factory role where you push a button and move on. The page you build is the page our ad spend lands on. If it's slow, ugly, or breaks on mobile, the whole campaign suffers. So we want someone who takes ownership of the build, not someone who just closes tasks.

 

You'd be the developer the team leans on to get things live, properly, the first time.

 

 

ABOUT MARKETING ONE  (M1)

Marketing One (M1) is founder-led. Carter has worked with Australian service businesses since 2015 across Google Ads, SEO, and web. We're hyper-niched on home services and law firms on purpose, because it lets us go deeper than generalist agencies can.

 

We're entering our next growth phase, and the websites and landing pages we build are a bigger and bigger part of how we win. You'd be coming in at a good time, with room to own the web build function as we scale.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Converting Figma designs into pixel-accurate Elementor pages (this is the core of the role)

- Building and maintaining client WordPress websites and high-converting landing pages

- Making sure every build is fast and clean, especially on mobile (Core Web Vitals matters here, because page speed feeds straight into Google Ads performance)

- Troubleshooting functional and technical issues across client sites

- Cleaning up bloated code, optimising images, keeping builds lean

- Setting up tracking elements and integrations as needed (forms, call tracking, third-party tools)

- Implementing on-page and technical SEO changes at the direction of our Head of SEO (meta data, schema, site structure, page speed fixes, plugin config)

- Recommending improvements rather than waiting to be told

- Keeping simple documentation so the team knows how a site is put together

 

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Loves being on the tools but actually cares why a page exists and what it needs to do

- Strong fundamentals. You can build and debug without leaning on AI to do the thinking for you

- Proactive problem solver, not just a task completer

- Self-directed with good prioritisation. We don't want to babysit

- Obsessive about detail. A 4px gap that doesn't match the Figma file should bother you

- Uses AI as a speed tool, not a crutch

- Communicates clearly in English, in writing and on calls

- Comfortable in a small, remote team where your work has visible impact

 

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- 3+ years specifically in Elementor (this is non-negotiable, general WordPress alone isn't enough)

- Strong WordPress development background

- Confident converting Figma designs into live Elementor pages, matching the design closely

- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP

- Solid understanding of Core Web Vitals and page speed optimisation

- Comfortable navigating APIs and third-party integrations

 

 

PREFERRED (nice to have, not required)

- Previous work with Australian companies

- Experience building for service-based businesses (trades, home services) or law firms

- Experience with landing pages built specifically for paid traffic

- Understanding of conversion tracking and how a page ties into ad campaigns

- Familiarity with SEO plugins like Rank Math (or Yoast), and a grasp of basic SEO fundamentals. Handy, not critical, since our Head of SEO directs the strategy

- Exposure to hosting / CDN setups (e.g. SiteGround, Cloudflare)

 

 

TOOLS YOU'LL USE

- Figma

- Elementor / WordPress

- Slack

- Google Suite

- Ahrefs

- Rank Math / Yoast SEO

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics (GA4)

 

 

WHY JOIN US

- Stable, full-time, fully remote role (work from home)

- A team that actually values clean, fast builds and notices when you nail one

- Direct impact. The pages you build carry real ad spend, so good work is obvious

- Clear leadership and structure, not a chaotic agency where nobody knows who owns what

- Ongoing work and the chance to grow long-term as we scale our web function 

 

EXPECTATIONS

- Work to AU (Brisbane) business hours

- Proper desk setup in a quiet, private space 



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide your resume by applying through onlinejobs.ph. Be sure to include 4-5 websites you have built using Elementor. The more complex the design is the better as it will give us an understanding of your skillset and ability to handle complex website designs.

 

If you've read this far, thank you. Follow the application steps above, and remember the keyword. We read every cover letter that follows the instructions, and bin the ones that don't.

- Send a same-day follow-up
 to anyone you speak with (template provided)

NOT CONSUMER COLD-CALLING

This is B2B outreach to healthcare professionals (discharge planners, social workers, hospice liaisons, elder law attorneys, senior placement agents like A Place for Mom and CarePatrol). No selling pressure. Just introducing our community and inviting them to refer families or come tour.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Pre-built contact list with phone numbers

- Scripts for each contact type

-
 templates

WHAT YOU NEED

- Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-leaning accent

- Reliable internet (10+ Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset

- Available during US Pacific business hours (8am–1pm PT = 11pm–4am PH)

PAY

Proficiency in QuickBooks is required.

description:
About Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors:

We are a dynamic financial services firm dedicated to providing tailored tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial services to both individuals and businesses. Our approach is client-centric, ensuring personalized service that meets the unique needs of each client for optimal outcomes. Staying abreast of tax law and financial trends, our expert team is committed to continuous learning and adaptation. Our mission is to empower clients by maintaining their financial health today and proactively planning for their tomorrow.



Role Overview:



Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors is seeking a highly capable Bookkeeper / Accounting Support Contractor to support client bookkeeping, accounting cleanup, financial reporting, and advisory preparation work. This role is ideal for a self-directed accounting professional who understands bookkeeping is more than data entry. We need someone who can review financial activity, identify issues, communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and help maintain clean, decision-ready books for business clients.

The role involves managing QuickBooks accounts, supporting clients, and contributing to our team's collaborative efforts to meet client needs. The ideal candidate has strong QuickBooks Online and Xero experience, understands accounting fundamentals, can manage client accounts independently, and communicates proactively when questions, issues, or bottlenecks arise. This role requires professional judgment, accountability, and the ability to work with limited supervision.



Primary Responsibilities:



Bookkeeping & Account Management

Maintain accurate books for assigned client accounts.

Categorize transactions properly based on client activity and accounting principles.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant accounts, payroll accounts, and other balance sheet accounts.

Review financial statements for obvious errors, inconsistencies, unusual balances, and missing activity.

Maintain clean, organized, and supportable books for each client.

Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual bookkeeping close processes.

Track outstanding client questions, missing documents, and unresolved transactions.

Support cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects when assigned.

Prepare client books for tax preparation, tax planning, or advisory review.



Accounting Review & Quality Control

Identify uncategorized, misclassified, duplicate, or unsupported transactions.

Review balance sheet accounts for reasonableness.

Flag negative loan balances, shareholder distributions, owner draws, retained earnings issues, payroll inconsistencies, and unusual expense activity.

Understand the difference between ordinary expenses, capital assets, loans, equity, distributions, and reimbursements.

Recognize when depreciation, amortization, fixed assets, loan treatment, payroll, or tax-sensitive classifications may require review.

Maintain documentation for bookkeeping decisions and client-provided support.

Escalate technical questions before making unsupported assumptions.



Software & Workflow

Work primarily in QuickBooks Online and Xero.

Use firm-approved project management, document management, and communication tools.

Follow established client workflows, task assignments, naming conventions, and deadlines.

Update task status clearly and consistently.

Document work performed, open issues, assumptions, and pending client needs.

Assist with process improvement when recurring problems are identified.



Client & Team Communication

Communicate clearly in writing and verbally.

Provide concise updates on work status, missing information, and client issues.

Ask focused questions when clarification is needed.

Communicate challenges early enough to protect deadlines.

Provide proposed solutions whenever possible.

Participate in scheduled internal check-ins as needed.

Maintain professionalism and confidentiality at all times.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Experience supporting tax firms, accounting firms, or advisory practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

Both QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor and Xero Advisor Certifications.

Experience independently managing client bookkeeping accounts.

Strong understanding of GAAP fundamentals.

Experience with multiple business types and industries.

Familiarity with U.S. small business tax concepts.

Familiarity with tax-sensitive bookkeeping concepts, including depreciation, capital assets, loans, payroll, owner equity, and deductible versus nondeductible expenses.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Must be able to pass a background check and be bondable due to access to confidential client financial information.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial data.



Preferred Qualifications

Have at least two U.S. based references. 

Experience preparing books for tax preparation or tax planning.

Payroll bookkeeping experience.

Experience with real estate, medical practices, professional services, construction, cannabis, retail, or service-based businesses.

Experience with cleanup bookkeeping projects.

Experience using workflow tools such as TaxDome, Basecamp, Trello, Asana, Karbon, Financial Cents, or similar platforms.

Experience with document request workflows and client communication tracking.



Technology, Security & Data Protection Requirements

Because this role involves access to confidential client financial records, tax-related documents, bookkeeping systems, and firm information, the contractor must maintain a secure remote work environment and comply with all firm technology and data protection requirements.



The contractor must be able to meet and maintain minimum security standards, including but not limited to:

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Secure, password-protected computer used for professional work.

Updated operating system and software.

Active anti-malware / antivirus protection.

Properly configured firewall protection.

Use of a firm-approved VPN when required.

Multi-factor authentication for all approved systems.

Secure password management practices.

No shared use of firm logins, client files, or confidential data.

No saving client documents to unauthorized personal devices, drives, or cloud storage.

Compliance with all firm procedures for document access, storage, transmission, and deletion.



The contractor must promptly report any suspected security issue, lost or compromised device, unauthorized access, malware i
, password compromise, or data exposure concern.



Failure to maintain required security standards may result in immediate removal of system access and termination of the contractor relationship.



Background Check, Bondability & Trust Requirements

Because this role involves access to sensitive client financial records, business accounts, tax-related documents, and confidential firm information, candidates must be able to successfully complete a background check and be bondable.

The selected contractor must demonstrate a professional history suitable for handling confidential financial information, client records, bookkeeping systems, and related account access. Any background concern that may affect financial trust, confidentiality, client security, or professional reliability must be disclosed during the screening process.

Candidates must also agree to follow all firm confidentiality, data security, document handling, password management, and client privacy requirements.



Contractor Classification

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor is responsible for managing their own work environment, equipment, internet access, taxes, insurance, and any other obligations associated with independent contractor status. This role does not create an employer-employee relationship.

title: Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:

As a Marketing Virtual Assistant, you will be responsible for providing support in various marketing tasks and projects, including marketing writing, content creation, WordPress management, product listing, and other marketing-related activities. The ideal candidate must be fluent in English, possess excellent writing skills, have attention to detail, and demonstrate creativity in marketing strategies. They must be able to work independently while following instructions to execute tasks and projects in a timely manner and communicate with consistent updates to their supervisors.



Responsibilities:

1. Marketing Writing: Create compelling marketing copy for various channels, including
s, social media posts, blog articles, website content, and advertisements.

2. Content Creation: Develop engaging and informative content to attract and retain our target audience. This may include articles, blog posts, case studies, infographics, videos, and more.

3. WordPress Management: Maintain and update the company's WordPress website, including publishing new content, optimizing existing content for SEO, and ensuring a seamless user experience.

4. Marketing Tasks and Projects: Assist in the planning, execution, and tracking of marketing campaigns and projects across multiple platforms. This may involve conducting market research, analyzing data, and preparing reports.

5. Social Media Management: Help manage and grow our social media presence by creating and scheduling posts, engaging with followers, and monitoring trends. (Bonus)

6. Administrative Support: Provide general administrative assistance to the marketing team as needed, including organizing files, scheduling meetings, and coordinating projects.

7. Affiliate Program Management: Assist in the management of our affiliate program by onboarding new affiliates, maintaining relationships with existing partners, and addressing their queries and concerns promptly. THIS IS A BIG BONUS





Requirements:

1. Fluent in English with exceptional writing and communication skills.

2. Proven experience in marketing writing and content creation.

3. Proficiency in WordPress and other content management systems.

4. Creative thinking and the ability to generate innovative marketing ideas.

5. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

6. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

7. Basic knowledge of SEO principles and best practices is a plus

8. Previous experience in affiliate marketing, digital marketing, or related fields is preferred.

9. Proficiency in using affiliate marketing platforms, tracking tools, and analytics software.

10. Proficiency in graphic design tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.

11. Prior experience as a virtual assistant or in a similar role is preferred.



Benefits:

1. Flexible work schedule with the opportunity for remote work.

2. Competitive compensation package based on experience and performance.

3. Professional development opportunities and room for growth within the company.

4. Joining a dynamic team of marketing professionals passionate about driving results and making an impact.



If you meet the above qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our marketing efforts, we encourage you to apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be a great fit for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Photo Editior
description:
JOB TITLE: E-Commerce Product Photo Editor — Color Correction & Retouching

Type: One-Time Project · Fixed-Price · Remote



ABOUT THE PROJECT

We have a batch of product photos (under 1,000 images) that need professional editing before they go live on our e-commerce store. We need every image to look polished, on-brand, and visually consistent — meaning uniform color grading, matched tones, corrected exposure, and a clean finish across the entire set. No image should look out of place when placed next to another.

The exact image count will be confirmed at project start. All work is fixed-price at $250 total for the full batch, paid upon delivery and approval.



TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS



Canvas Size: 2048 × 2048 px

Max File Size: Under 500 KB per file

Color Mode: sRGB

Resolution: 72 DPI (web-optimized)





DELIVERABLES PER IMAGE (2 versions)

Version 1 — PNG with Transparent Background

Clean cutout, product only, no background. Edges must be precise — no fringing, halos, or rough selections.

Version 2 — JPEG with White Background

Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, optimized compression to stay under 500 KB without sacrificing visible quality.



WHAT WE NEED DONE



Scale and position every product consistently within the 2048×2048 frame

Color correct and color match all images so tone, white balance, and saturation are uniform across the full batch

Retouch any imperfections — dust, reflections, uneven lighting, or blemishes on the product

Background removal (PNG) with clean, professional edges — not auto-select quality

Flatten to white (JPEG) with proper file compression to stay under 500 KB

Deliver a cohesive, catalog-ready set where every image looks like it belongs together





YOU'RE THE RIGHT FIT IF...



You have proven experience editing product photos for e-commerce (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, etc.)

You work in Photoshop, Lightroom, or equivalent professional tools

You have a sharp eye for color consistency and can match tones across an entire batch

Your background removal work is clean at a professional standard — pen tool or equivalent, not magic wand

You're comfortable with a fixed-price arrangement and can give a realistic turnaround estimate before starting

You communicate proactively and deliver organized, properly named files on time





BUDGET

$250 USD fixed for the full batch (under 1,000 images). This works out to roughly $0.25–$0.50 per image depending on final count — a fair rate for experienced editors based in the Philippines. Payment upon delivery and client approval.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:



3–5 portfolio samples of past product photo editing (before/after preferred)

Your estimated turnaround time for a batch of this size

A brief note on your workflow and tools



Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

Shortlist properties based on design, size, lighting, view, layout, price, and overall aesthetic.

Build clear comparison sheets with links, images, notes, pros, cons, and final recommendations.



Think independently and filter out low-quality or generic properties before sending them to me.



Requirements:



Strong eye for interior design, architecture, and luxury aesthetics.



Excellent English communication.



Very strong attention to detail.



Ability to research deeply and compare multiple platforms.



Ability to understand a creative direction and find properties that match it.

A short explanation of why you are good at this type of research.

title: E-Commerce Bookkeeping/Accounting Assistant
description:
About Us

Vets2Pets is a fast-growing pet wellness brand based in South Africa. We sell supplements for dogs and cats through Takealot, Shopify, and soon Amazon UK.



We’re looking for a part-time Finance & Operations Assistant who is confident working with Excel, understands accounting and reconciliations, and has experience managing e-commerce platforms. You will work directly with the founders to keep the backend of the business running smoothly.

This is a role for someone who wants long-term growth in a remote team, not a short-term virtual assistant position.



Key Responsibilities

E-Commerce Platform Management

* Monitor and process orders across Shopify and Amazon

* Update inventory in CIN7 Core and ensure SKUs/barcodes are accurate

* Track order flow, deliveries, and warehouse shipments



Inventory & Financial Tracking

* Maintain Excel spreadsheets for:

* Stock levels

* Purchase orders and restocking schedules

* Reconcile inbound stock with supplier invoices

* Flag low inventory and assist with restocking decisions



Accounting Support & Reconciliation

* Record and track supplier payments and invoices

* Assist with Xero bookkeeping (expenses, POs, supplier payments)

* Reconcile monthly transactions between Shopify and Xero

* Help prepare cash flow updates and simple management reports



Must-Have Skills

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency?(You must be able to build and manage spreadsheets with formulas, VLOOKUP, PivotTables, etc.)

* Working knowledge of accounting?(Understanding of cost of goods, purchase orders, invoice matching, and basic reconciliations)

* Experience managing Shopify, Takealot, or similar platforms

* Familiarity with inventory systems like CIN7 Core, DEAR, or Zoho

* Good English communication skills (written and verbal)

* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently



Nice to Have (Not Required)

* Experience using Xero

* Worked in e-commerce, supplements, or pet wellness industries



What Success Looks Like (First 3 Months)

* All orders processed and platforms updated daily with no errors

* Inventory and stock reports in Excel are clean, accurate, and up to date

* All invoices, payments, and PO records are properly reconciled

* Weekly reports submitted on time, without needing reminders

* You're asking smart questions and proactively solving issues



Application Instructions

To apply, please visit our website: 

1. Find our Omega-3 Oil product

2. Work out what discount is currently being offered

3. Start your
 subject line with the discount amount?(Example: “20% – Application for Finance & Ops Role”)

In your application, include the following:

* A short voice recording introducing yourself (1–2 minutes)

* Your updated CV



We are only reviewing applications that follow all the steps above, so please read carefully.



This is a part-time remote role with potential to grow into a full-time position by 2026.

We’re looking for someone dependable, detail-focused, and committed to joining our business long-term. If you enjoy working with spreadsheets, understand how e-commerce businesses run behind the scenes, and can manage financial data — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist for a Supplement Brand
description:
We are a fast-growing premium supplement brand focused on science-backed formulations, longevity, and performance optimization. Our mission is to build category-defining products supported by strong education, compelling storytelling, and high-converting creative.



We are now looking for a Creative Strategist with proven supplement experience who understands how to translate health science into persuasive, compliant, high-performing ad creatives.



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who has already built and scaled winning campaigns in the supplement space.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will own the ideation and direction of performance-driven ad creatives across Meta, (maybe TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels in the future)



You must understand:



• Supplement consumer psychology

• Compliance limitations in health claims

• UGC scripting and hooks

• Direct response frameworks

• Performance metrics such as CTR, thumb stop rate, CPA, and ROAS



Your job is simple in theory and demanding in execution: develop creatives that convert.



Responsibilities



• Develop high-converting ad concepts based on data and competitor research

• Write scroll-stopping hooks and scripts for UGC and founder ads

• Build creative briefs for video editors and content creators

• Analyze ad performance and iterate quickly

• Identify winning angles and scale them

• Conduct competitive analysis within the supplement space

• Align creative with brand positioning and long-term growth strategy



Requirements



• Proven experience working with supplement brands (mandatory)

• Demonstrated track record of winning ad creatives

• Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok ad ecosystems

• Ability to balance compliance with persuasive messaging

• Experience scaling offers such as subscriptions, bundles, or AOV lifts

• Data-driven mindset



Application Requirements:



To be considered, you must submit:

1. Portfolio of previous supplement brands you’ve worked with

2. Examples of winning ads (video links preferred)

3. Performance metrics where possible (CPA, ROAS, CTR, etc.)

4. Brief explanation of why the creatives worked

5. Your availability and rate



Applications without supplement experience will not be considered.



What We Offer



• Fast-moving team with strong growth ambitions

• Long-term opportunity with performance upside

• Freedom to test bold ideas backed by data

• Collaborative, execution-focused culture



If you understand how to sell supplements without sounding like everyone else in the market, we want to hear from you.



Apply by sending your portfolio and best performing creatives.

description:
Hiring for a React Three Fiber / Three.js Developer with Blender Experience

We already have a private client website. It is functional but still basic. The role is to add a premium 3D anatomy layer to the platform and significantly improve the overall experience.



The ideal person is not just a frontend developer and not just a 3D artist. You should be comfortable working across both web and 3D workflows.



The work includes:





Finding and sourcing high-quality anatomy and medical-style 3D assets. This may include skulls, teeth, oral anatomy, airway structures, soft tissue, bone structures, and similar models.

Editing, cleaning, optimising, and adapting these models in Blender or similar software. Models should look professional, premium, and educational rather than cheap, game-like, or templated.

Optimising models for web performance. This includes polygon reduction, texture optimisation, material cleanup, GLB/GLTF preparation, loading optimisation, and ensuring smooth performance across desktop and mobile devices.

Implementing the models directly into the website using React Three Fiber, Three.js, WebGL, or a similar stack.

Creating interactions around the models. This may include camera movements, highlighting structures, annotations, labels, layer visibility controls, guided educational views, animations, and other interactive features.

Improving the overall UI/UX so the platform feels modern, premium, and enjoyable to use rather than feeling like a basic LMS.





This is not a role for somebody who only uses AI tools or generates mockups. AI can be used where helpful, but you should be capable of independently solving frontend, performance, interaction, and 3D implementation problems.



Great fit if you have experience with:





React Three Fiber

Three.js

WebGL

Blender

GLB / GLTF workflows

3D model optimisation

Interactive educational platforms

The Role

We are looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper who doesn't just do things "the old way." You will be responsible for managing our core financial records, but with a significant twist: you should be comfortable leveraging AI tools and database matching to streamline our reconciliations and reporting.

You'll be the engine that keeps each client's campaigns on track — building creator lists, producing proposals, and keeping bookings and follow-ups from slipping.

This is a graveyard-shift role: you must be online and reachable from 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Pacific Time (roughly 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time). Please only apply if you can commit to those hours long-term.

We're an early, fast-moving team, so the scope of this role will shift as we grow. It suits someone who wants more on their plate over time, takes on new problems without waiting for perfect instructions, and treats being handed more responsibility as the point — not the burden.

What you'll do:



Build and vet influencer/creator lists for active campaigns, organized cleanly in spreadsheets/Airtable

Produce client proposals in Gamma and PowerPoint/Google Slides

Manage creator booking, swapping, and follow-ups across several campaigns at once

Run creator and seeding outreach (DM/email) to source new creators and pages as needed

Scan each client's space weekly for relevant pitch and placement opportunities

Own a set of direct creator relationships on the ground



Must-haves:



2+ years in a coordination, VA, or campaign-support role

Able to reliably work the 10am–6pm PT graveyard window

Comfortable building decks in Gamma and/or PowerPoint/Google Slides

Strong written English and confident running outbound outreach to creators

Organized enough to track many moving pieces across multiple clients without dropping a follow-up

Comfortable in a role whose scope changes month to month

Reliable internet and a dedicated workspace



Nice-to-haves:



Experience with music marketing, the creator economy, or social campaigns for artists/brands

Familiarity with Airtable, Slack, 
, and creator outreach at volume



To apply, include a one-line note on the influencer or social campaigns you've supported. Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short Google Form to complete before a 20-minute video interview.

title: Finance Senior Executive (AP/AR/GL) - 100% Remote
description:
Company Overview: Truegenics Pte Ltd is a personal care Vitamin, Mineral, and Supplement (VMS) company that specializes in Direct Response marketing. We sell our own brand of health supplements to a global audience and strive to add more life into their days. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.



Mission of the Role: To ensure the financial stability and integrity of Truegenics by efficiently managing day-to-day payment cycle activities and controlling expenses, while providing accurate and timely financial reporting for the group. You will assist in the preparation of the management reports and analysis, including but not limited to monthly reports. This role actively contributes to sound financial administration, supports management with insightful analysis, and fosters effective collaboration across the finance division. 



This role starts off as a 6-month contract role, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent position subject to business needs, performance, and role renewal.



Key Responsibilities:

- Ensure accurate and timely recording of accounting journals and intercompany transactions in compliance with the Group’s accounting and reporting policies.

- Reconcile bank accounts, intercompany balances and inventories to maintain data integrity and proper asset management.

- Prepare monthly management reports, including consolidation, variance, and Profit and Loss analysis.

- Support month-end closing, cashflow variance reporting, and departmental budget analysis to provide accurate and timely financial insights.

- Backup support for processing of weekly payments.

- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. auditors, bankers, vendors) to resolve financial queries and facilitate smooth operations.

- Support all statutory and regulatory compliance, including preparing for annual audits, tax computations, and annual XBRL filings.

- Handle any other ad-hoc projects or tasks as assigned.



Key Skills & Experience:

- Hold a good University Degree or relevant Professional Qualification.

- In-depth knowledge of accounting and reporting processes, with at least 2-3 years of working experience in handling full set accounting in a medium/large organization.

- Comfortable adopting or exploring automation and AI tools for process optimization and financial analysis 

- Familiar with Singapore Financial Reporting Standards and Corporate Tax statutory requirement.

- Proficient in Microsoft office and Google sheets.

- Familiar with telegraphic transfers and overseas payment processes will be a plus. 

- Familiar with Xero system will be a plus.

- Well organized, meticulous, analytical and able to work independently.

- Good communication and interpersonal skills in English.

- A good team player and able to work under pressure.

 

Working Arrangement:

This is a 100% remote role where the potential hire must be equipped with the following to carry out this role effectively:

- Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed

- At least 2 monitor screen (inclusive of laptop screen)

- Headset with Mic (Noise cancelling)

- Webcam

- Designated Workstation

- Stable and strong power and internet connectivity

- Noise-free and conducive environment

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

 Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization 

 Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and evolving digital marketing systems, with a proactive approach to staying updated on and exploring emerging industry trends.

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking) 

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands 

Experience optimizing
 revenue and customer retention funnels 

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule 

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required 

Must be fully available for US hours 



What We Offer

Full-time remote role 

Training provided 

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions. 





1. Describe your experience with paid advertising, particularly on TikTok Ads. What does your typical daily workflow look like when managing and optimizing e-commerce campaigns? Please include the platforms you’ve worked with (e.g., TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.).

2. Do you have experience working with platform algorithms and ensuring ad compliance while optimizing performance? If yes, briefly provide an example.



All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. Shortlisted will receive an
 invite for the next steps.

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Home Services (U.S. Markets)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior SEO Specialist who understands what it takes to rank home services companies in competitive U.S. local markets.

This is a hands-on execution role — not strategy-only. You will be responsible for on-page SEO, technical SEO, content optimization, and local SEO execution, following clearly defined SOPs while also contributing to their improvement over time.

If you’ve ranked HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, hardscape, pressure washing, or similar service businesses — and you know how Google Business Profiles, local pages, and service-area SEO really work — this role is for you.

________________________________________

On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

• Optimize service pages, city pages, and blogs for local and service-based keywords

• Write or optimize SEO content that converts (service pages, FAQs, blogs, location pages)

• Implement proper H1–H6 structure, internal linking, schema, and CTAs

• Optimize pages for search intent, not just keywords

Technical SEO

• Conduct full technical SEO audits and implement fixes:

o Core Web Vitals

o Indexation & crawlability

o Site structure & internal linking

o Redirects, canonicals, noindex rules

• Work within WordPress environments (including common builders)

• Collaborate with developers when needed (you must know what to ask for)

Local SEO (Critical)

• Optimize Google Business Profiles (categories, services, photos, posts, FAQs)

• Support citation consistency and NAP accuracy

• Build and optimize city/service-area pages

• Understand proximity, relevance, and prominence factors

SOP Execution & Improvement

• Follow established SEO SOPs consistently

• Help improve and document new SOPs as processes evolve

• Track tasks, deliverables, and results with strong attention to detail

Tools & Reporting

• Use SEO tools to track rankings, audits, and progress

• Experience with Search Atlas is a major plus

• Ability to explain SEO results clearly to internal stakeholders

________________________________________

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

• 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience

• Proven experience ranking U.S.-based home services businesses

• Strong on-page SEO and technical SEO skills

• Experience working inside WordPress

• Ability to write or heavily edit SEO content (clear, helpful, human)

• Experience working with local SEO and Google Business Profiles

• Process-driven mindset — you can follow and improve SOPs

• Strong written communication and documentation skills

Nice-to-Have (Pluses)

• Experience with Search Atlas

• Experience with BrightLocal, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog

• Understanding of schema for local businesses and services

• Experience working in an agency environment

• Basic understanding of CRO for service-based websites
